nom: Hero Cosmetics Pimple Correct Acne Clearing Gel Pen

segments.dry: One reviewer with dry skin and occasional acne says the pen always clears it quickly.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers who describe their skin as sensitive report the product is gentle enough for them, with one adding it also felt hydrating and moisturizing.
segments.mature: A 55-year-old reviewer reports it cleared stubborn scalp/forehead acne that had resisted other treatments for six years.

concerns.spots: Most reviewers who mention individual pimples or zits report they shrink or disappear within one to a few nights of spot use; a few say it made no visible difference to their spots.
concerns.blemishes: Several report blemishes and their redness fading quickly with nightly use, though two say it did nothing for their blemishes and one says it left a peeling film.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer applies it alongside an oil at night and reports good results, but no reviewer specifically discusses oil control as an effect of the product.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer with a history of skin problems reports the product does not solve underlying skin issues but reduces flare severity when used consistently; another reports it caused a bacterial buildup and worse breakouts.
concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers note the treatment dries out or flakes the treated spot, which some see as part of it working and others find uncomfortably drying, with one describing burning skin requiring constant moisturizing.

aspects.libelle: Requires forceful priming trick to work

extraits.texte: Dried out my skin and irritated it to the point where it would burn if i didnt constantly moisturize or lotion. Looks like i fell into poison ivy.

I was excited about this product but it just made everything worse. It did dry out my zits for a few days but caused a build up of bacteria underneath my skin. Now i have big painful zits on my forehead. Although i have heard this product works great for some people, but for people whp have highly acne prone skin, this is definitely not recommended.

extraits.titre: Love this product!! But a few issues
extraits.texte: I absolutely loved this product!! It worked really well with my skin. Ive been a person who has been looking for a whole bunch of different products, and non of them had worked until i tried the serum. Its pretty hydrating and moisturizing and could see results after just one use. The packaging however definitely could be improved because it took is forever on how to open it. Overall, I would highly recommend to anyone who had acne and is great for sensitive skin. ✨

extraits.titre: Daily use reduced cystic acne but maybe not solo use.
extraits.texte: The good news is I don't have the excessive cystic acne I'm used to constantly fighting with unless a hair follicle grows the wrong way. While that's still pretty frequent, that's still a huge reduction of what I was dealing with. I'm finally waking up to tiny pinhole pimples instead of a hairline of cysts and two or three giant cysts on my chin and nose begging for relief (which usually get the zit sticker treatment). I've had to consistently add this to my routine and really use it. I'm almost through my first entire gel stick and I'm finally noticing a difference. It doesn't stop other skin problems, but we're fighting off some of the pimples and making them easier to deal with. It's less stressful. Given my health problems cause other skin issues, I'm pleased. I was hoping, given the promises, there would be a little more... but maybe by making this a permanent part of the routine, I'll achieve what I wanted. So since it didn't conquer all my problems, I think that's four stars. You might really need to get used to using this in combination with zit stickers for maximum benefit.
I get bad painful cystic acne on my cheecks and it literally works over night. I do not use any other acne treatments, i just apply my moisturizer and oil at night then apply it to my pimples.

Don't ask me why at age 55 I'm still getting acne and why it's on my scalp. All I know is this pen has been amazing at applying the medicine and clearing these pesky little things off my forehead and scalp. No lie, I had one that has been resisting medicine for 6 years (neosporin, aquafor, cortisol, etc.) and this pen cleared it up and it's completely gone. I apply it at night so I don't accidentally rub it off. It absorbs quickly too so it's not on my pillow either. LOVE THIS PRODUCT!!!
I am not sure how this works for more intense acne, but I have dry skin with occasional acne, and this always helps get rid of it quickly.
